channel.title: GitHub Rust Languages Daily Trending
channel.description: Daily Trending of Rust Languages in GitHub

item.title: akitaonrails / ai-memory
item.description: Solution for long term memory for agent coding CLIs and to facilitate handoff between different agent vendors

item.title: xerj-org / xerj
item.description: XERJ is the new way for AI to search data. Its autoindex capability activates agents to know your data without the token waste of grep (1974 tool). One command indexes code, docs, logs and PDFs for search, RAG, security audits and agent memory, using 40x fewer tokens than grep. It’s durable and can replace ElasticSearch saving you x10 infra costs.

item.title: rtk-ai / rtk
item.description: CLI proxy that reduces LLM token consumption by 60-90% on common dev commands. Single Rust binary, zero dependencies

item.title: mixelpixx / Konnect
item.description: AI-assisted PCB design for KiCAD 10. Native KiCAD plugin — a single Rust binary exposing 217 schematic, layout, routing, placement, design-review, and manufacturing tools to Claude, or the LLM of your choosing

item.title: googleworkspace / cli
item.description: Google Workspace CLI — one command-line tool for Drive, Gmail, Calendar, Sheets, Docs, Chat, Admin, and more. Dynamically built from Google Discovery Service. Includes AI agent skills.

item.title: rubys / roundhouse
item.description: Rails as a specification; the deployment target is a build flag

item.title: Automattic / harper
item.description: Offline, privacy-first grammar checker. Fast, open-source, Rust-powered

item.title: GCWing / OpenBitFun
item.description: OpenBitFun combines a high-performance agent runtime written in Rust with a polished desktop application. It pairs the depth of a Code Agent with open, general-purpose capabilities for work beyond software development.

item.title: claration / impactor
